arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Clement asserts service advisors are plainly salespeople engaged in servicing cars.
Feldman contends service advisors do not service automobiles and lack exemption status.
Kagan challenged the reliance on literal statutory meaning over other arguments.
Ginsburg inquired whether unlisted roles can subsume under the three statutory categories.
